column3: “So they may be crushed” is rendered “They are even oppressed.”
The Hebrew of this verse is difficult; “to from thorns” is rendered “to a place of thorns,” and “a snare” as “the schemer.” The meaning is uncertain.
“The children of flame” is rendered “sparks,” and “make high to fly” as “fly upward.”
“The surface of the earth” is rendered “the earth,” and “the open places” as “the fields.”
“It is hasty” is rendered “is quickly thwarted.”
“From the sword from their mouth” is rendered “from the sword of their mouth.”
“May bind up” is rendered “gives relief,” and “shatters” as “wounds.”
“In six troubles” is rendered “From six troubles.”
“Hands of the sword” is rendered “power of the sword.”
“Destruction” is rendered “violence,” and “animals of the earth” as “wild beasts.”
“Your covenant will be with” is rendered “you will be in league with.”
“Safety” is rendered “secure,” and “estate” as “abode.” “Not you will miss” is rendered “fear no loss.”
“As a heap of sheaves goes up” is rendered “Like the stacking of grain.”
